title.label: Perfect app for simple habit tracking

content.label: Have been using this app for a week now and I can say it’s working great for me. I love the minimalistic yet well thought out design, ease of use and customization features. Exactly the tool I needed to help me actually follow through with my habit goals. I wish they added more statistics and made the widgets more interactive. The watch app is also slightly laggy. Other than that it’s great app. 9/10 use of $7.

name.label: h I ig. g ig i gig. h

content.label: Excited to be forming good habits!

Setting up my habits was easy. However - when I complete them on my Apple Watch, I still get reminders to complete them later in the day.  Somehow it’s not syncing to my phone. Support wasn’t helpful and there aren’t help articles about this problem.
Great idea I find it very counterintuitive please give me a refund

This is a decent, useful app, but some of my tasks disappear and become difficult to find.  This is especially true after I complete one for the day, which…I get it.  You think I want a list of things I still need to do.  The problem is that I want to see how many days I have met the task in question.  You know, I want to see the actual streak!

Worse, a task I completed yesterday doesn’t always return the next morning.  😡😡😡😡😡
I have recommended this app to my physical therapist, my gym training group, my artist group, my doctor, and my cheesemonger. This is not hyperbole. I'm actually achieving my goals.
I feel this app is generic and I feel I wasted my money

I figured the app would offer more and be easier to navigate considering it costs money. I was wanting a habit tracker that had a solid calendar view of my progress and also allowed me to keep unlimited habits. I like that I can have unlimited habits, but I don’t like that I cannot have bi-weekly habits. The way to schedule habits is a little bit confusing and I’m getting notifications for habits on days I didn’t schedule them. The calendar view is the biggest disappointment of the app. It’s small, difficult to read, and it’s more of a timeline than a calendar. Since I payed for the app, I’m going to use it. It works for the most part and is great if you just want to see all of your habits in one spot and see what you have and have not done yet. But if you want anything more, I would suggest looking elsewhere.
Love the app, but the only thing that kinda annoys me is the "do you want to undo last ... " message that pops up every time i keep the app open. Not sure if I can turn that off somehow.
I especially love that it connects to Apple health so everything just works

title.label: Mac version is syncing correctly now

content.label:
UPDATE: I reinstalled Streaks on my new Mac and it’s been syncing changes with my iPhone just fine. The devs seem to have fixed the issues I ran into previously, so I’m upping the Mac version to 5 stars, matching my rating of the iOS version.

ORIGINAL:
I made major changes to my habits—changing some existing ones and added new ones on my phone—this morning. I hadn't used my MacBook in a few days, and after using it I realized that instead of syncing all of my latest changes from my phone to my MBP, Streaks did the opposite and replaced all the work I'd done today with the days-old versions from my Mac. I'm still leaving my 5 star rave review on the iOS app store because I really like Streaks, but I've already deleted the app from my Mac.

title.label: Good start, needs more task tracking

content.label:
I am at six tasks and unable to add any more. There are many types of habits that I would like to develop, but it seems that Streaks doesn’t want to go there. 

I get that it is important to be focused by not trying to do too much at once, but I am capable of more.
Needs more Tasks. I wish it had more then 24 tasks.I have ADD with Executive Function disorder and this helps me so much but its limited. PLEASE ADD MORE TASK, PLEASE!!!
Easy, fun, habit creating, never mind all the other checklists and so on, this is all you need!

This app actually helps track my habits. It’s hard to wind down for the day with all these personal goals set, and not achieved. I like how you can pause goals as life changes and it doesn’t mess with your mental that you’re not progressing. Amazing app, gifted my sister this app as well!
Great app for daily habit tracking. Has functionality on all Mac devices from MacBook, iPad, iphone, and apple watch.
I find this extremely helpful in creating long lasting good habits.   Great intuitive interface.

title.label: Good but give me better options

content.label: Please give me better color options or let me customize my backgrounds and icon colors. I bought this app years ago and it’s so useful but the colorways offered are so offputting. I’m just a girl who wants my streak pages to have inviting light colors. And also maybe let me add notes under my tasks since i only get 28 char for my titles
This app is slowly changing my life. Very intuitive and everything you need.

title.label: Keeps me motivated. Very well written.

content.label: I use this to keep track of 6 streaks and it has been a boon to motivate me to keep going to the YMCA for exercise and walking our dog etc. Works great on the iPhone and nicely ties into the Apple Watch too.
If there was a way to have 8 habits in one page this would be a 5 star app

This app has motivated me to exercise more and clean something every day. The interaction and graphics are fun! Rewards me with a visual positive feeling of accomplishment every day. Was worth the money.
Would not sync with Apple Watch. Tried uninstalling, restarting, etc multiple times to correct but nothing worked.  Ultimately I had to delete and begin the search for a new habit tracker app.

This is a good app and I’ve been using it for a long time but I don’t understand why after years of updating the app the developers voluntarily limit the number of habits to 24. That gives competitor apps an edge that could easily be corrected. I personally ended up using more other tracking apps than this one because of this limit, even though this is a great app. Some of us manage more tasks and want to track more data, for example for business, not only personal tasks. Another thing is that there’s very few apps that offer team habit completion for partners or couples (mostly focused on house chores), this app could easily get an edge on that market too since it offers habit sharing. But the problem is that 24 habit limit interface design that in my opinion is more arbitrary (maybe trying to keep it simple) than profitable. More habits does not mean less simplicity. Simplicity is achieved through the interface design, not through limiting the number of data.
Also it would be nice to let mark habits as completed from the widget and not having to open the app all the time. Please consider these suggestions. It’s a good app but it could still be improved. Thank you
Great basic habit tracking app if you value simplicity

Your latest update just broke your widgets. You can no long customize them. It shows the ability to customize them but nothing changes when you make the customizations. Also, I wish you had a large widget, showing the habits in a list form, and the days of the week that you complete the habit.
I love this app. Works well ad has a great UI. Could use a bit more speed when syncing between devices, otherwise great app.
thank yu.
This app changed my life

title.label: How do I make this work?

content.label: Maybe I accidentally skipped the tutorial? Was excited about the app and followed the setup instructions. But now I have no idea how to tell it I did the thing. And tapping the ? doesn’t help.

I used many habit trackers in the past but, this one is the one to beat because it just allows you easily just gamify your otherwise daily mundane tasks. It has done so much for me and I only wish I could give it more than 5 stars.
Amazing and simple app that lets me set daily or weekly tasks and keeps track of them. Allows me to gamify my life!
The app is really good is gonna  make you follow your habits more consistently than ever it is that good

Its an amazing yet simple app. My only concern is that it takes very long most of the times to update info done in the iphone app and sync it to the apple watch one. I own some other apps which update almost instantly. Please check that out! Thanks for the app very nice
Strangest thing is it’s way too easy to delete all your existing data and your entire task history is gone.

The widget does not update unless you launch it. I get that widget refresh is restricted by Apple but I put Streaks side by side against StepsApp then didn’t touch either all day. StepsApp would update a few times per hour; Streaks never updated once. The entire point of a widget is to update and show information without having to launch the app.

Additionally, it simply does not reflect the display order of my streaks and instead just displays them in whatever order it wants, despite me checking the option to do it by display order so I can see relevant tasks at relevant times.

If I didn’t care about widgets, this would be a five-star app. But I do, so sadly until these issues are fixed, two stars is an accurate representation of the quality of my experience.

title.label: Great app for building habits, personal streaks, and continuity!

content.label: Really enjoy the simplicity of this app as it helps clearly label some goals and ideas you’re working on and gently reminds you to keep going. It automatically increases or reduces your goal depending on how often you’re achieving or missing the goal. Overall, it’s simple and great for my ADHD brain!

Been using this app for about a month and I’m fairly happy with it. Took me a while to figure out how to use it and set up different tasks. 
The reason for the 3 stars is because it keeps deleting tasks I’ve marked as completed. Yesterday I completed every single task, marked them all completed and they all turned yellow but this morning as I was marking a task completed the system told me I had missed yesterday’s  and now my streak is messed up. This has happened a couple of times before but I just assumed that I had missed those tasks. 
Please fix glitch.

Really nice app. I like the  aesthetics, it’s simple and straightforward to use. Decent customization. 

I do wish it could sync with Apple Reminders and Calendars though
I like this app a lot it’s made me make some improvements that all in all were pretty simple, but this app helped me stay consistent

If you’re looking for a simple and effective habit tracking app, I’d recommend giving this one a try! I knew myself well enough to know if it was too complicated, I wouldn’t use it. Well worth the small up-front cost!
Awesome. Happy that it’s just a one time fee
was very useful and intuitive but it's so buggy lately, everything from the widget display order, focus filters, moving a task to a different page, has been an issue for me.  pls fix, I like this app

title.label: At first I didn’t get it, but then I loved it

content.label: Okay, this app is for me. It took a second to get used to the user interface, but once I got everything set up on my phone and Mac with the widgets and shortcuts for each action, it became a very simple but very dynamic app that I find very satisfying and easy to use everyday

Whether it’s the watch app or the widget or shortcuts something is always not quite right with Streaks. I can launch the app, mark a task complete, and go back to Home Screen without the widget updating. Shortcuts are broken - they aren’t showing all tasks or marking them complete from what I can. Overall it’s best in the most basic form only.

This app is absolutely perfect. I’ve been using it for almost a decade by now probably. All I need left is UNLIMITED STREAKS. I have to use a million other worse apps because this doesn’t allow more than like 24 streaks. I have so much more I want to track and see the stats for but there’s just not enough. I can’t only pick 24. There’s more than 24 things I need this app for. Also, no other app is this good and has these features and UI, etc. all I want to make this app absolutely goated is unlimited streaks. Literally all I need is that. Other than that, the app is perfect.
This app is not intuitive. It is impossible to get statistics for an item once it has been completed.

This app seems like it would be really useful but it isn’t the most intuitive to use. The tutorial in the app doesn’t really explain the basics like how to add a task, how to sort them, etc. I just had to kind of mess with it and figure it out. 
I mainly got this for the Pomodoro and was wanting to figure out how to reset the timer which is only when I figured out how to add others. 
Then I finally inputted 6 tasks and wasn’t sure how to add more since swiping didn’t lead to any other pages. But the tutorial said up to 24 could be added, so again I just had to fumble through until I clicked something that let me swipe the page to add more. 

I noticed we can add categories for tasks also, but it seems pointless since I can’t see where there is a way to sort tasks or pages based off those categories. I ended up manually sorting tasks by daily, weekly, and monthly. It would be nice if we could label the pages to make it clear which page it is.
I love it but I would want a limitless number of habits to build and more templates would be helpful.
No part of this app is worth it, I downloaded in the hopes of keep track of my weekly tasks. However it’s clunky, and awkward to use.
